name: google-forms
label: Google Forms
description: Receive form responses from Google Forms

forms_get_form.label: Get Form
forms_get_form.description: Fetch a form's full structure: title, settings, items with their indices and itemIds, question IDs, and current revisionId.

form_id.label: Form ID
form_id.description: The ID of the form to fetch. Obtain it from forms_list_responses or the New Response trigger.

forms_list_responses.label: List Form Responses
forms_list_responses.description: List submitted responses for a form, with each response's responseId, timestamps, and answers keyed by questionId.

form_id.label: Form ID
form_id.description: The ID of the form whose responses to list. Obtain it from forms_get_form or the New Response trigger.

filter.label: Filter
filter.description: Optional filter on submission time, e.g. "timestamp > 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z" or "timestamp < 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z". Only the timestamp field is supported.

page_size.label: Page Size
page_size.description: Maximum number of responses to return per page (default 5000).

page_token.label: Page Token
page_token.description: Token from a previous call's nextPageToken to fetch the next page of responses.

forms_list_responses.afterResponse:
var responses = response.responses || [];
return { responses: responses, count: responses.length, nextPageToken: response.nextPageToken };

forms_get_response.label: Get Form Response
forms_get_response.description: Fetch one submission by its responseId, including all answers keyed by questionId and submission timestamps.

form_id.label: Form ID
form_id.description: The ID of the form the response belongs to. Obtain it from forms_list_responses or the New Response trigger.

response_id.label: Response ID
response_id.description: The ID of the response to fetch. Obtain it from forms_list_responses or the New Response trigger.
